description: ASP.NET Core Web API controller for managing customers, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers.

classes.name: CustomersController
classes.description: API controller for customer operations, handling HTTP requests related to customer data.

methods.name: GetCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list customers with pagination and optional search.

methods.name: GetCustomerById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a customer by their ID.

methods.name: CreateCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer.

methods.name: UpdateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer.

methods.name: DeleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer.
